basis: Accepted submission row 37: v36 plus the frozen published-mean correction.

admission.rule: At least two 2025 January/July training rows in month-airport-class cell

local_selection.reason: The published held-month aggregate contains held labels; leaving the month out of coverage coefficients does not remove that path. The v24 bias prior and v36 base also retain known label paths.

reproduction_limits: Saved-value replay verifies six hashes, then applies the frozen correction; no fresh fit ran.
A new fit needs both complete component routes, published monthly source values and raw/open-clock class rows for the support rule.
The workbook is not distributed. EUROCONTROL source information retains its own terms, separate from GPLv3 code.
